package unit

import (
	"context"
	"testing"
	"time"

	"github.com/google/uuid"

	"github.com/example/ms-go-statistic/internal/domain"
	"github.com/example/ms-go-statistic/internal/infrastructure/persistence/clickhouse"
)

type fakeBatch struct {
	records [][]any
	sendErr error
}

func (f *fakeBatch) Append(values ...any) error {
	f.records = append(f.records, values)
	return nil
}

func (f *fakeBatch) Send() error {
	return f.sendErr
}

type fakeConn struct {
	lastQuery string
	batch     *fakeBatch
	err       error
}

func (f *fakeConn) PrepareBatch(_ context.Context, query string) (clickhouse.BatchWriter, error) {
	f.lastQuery = query
	return f.batch, f.err
}

func TestEventRepository_InsertBatch(t *testing.T) {
	batch := &fakeBatch{}
	conn := &fakeConn{batch: batch}
	repo := clickhouse.NewEventRepositoryWithConn(conn, "stat_events")

	now := time.Now()
	ev := domain.Event{
		EventTS:    now,
		UserID:     uuid.New(),
		Role:       "student",
		SessionID:  uuid.New(),
		CourseID:   uuid.New(),
		LessonID:   uuid.New(),
		TaskID:     uuid.New(),
		Platform:   "web",
		EditorMode: "html",
		ClientTS:   &now,
		EventType:  domain.EventTypeKeyPress,
		Payload:    []byte(`{"key":"a"}`),
	}

	if err := repo.InsertBatch(context.Background(), []domain.Event{ev}); err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("insert batch returned error: %v", err)
	}

	if conn.lastQuery == "" {
		t.Fatalf("expected PrepareBatch to be called")
	}
	if len(batch.records) != 1 {
		t.Fatalf("expected 1 record, got %d", len(batch.records))
	}
	if got := batch.records[0][5]; got != uuid.Nil {
		t.Fatalf("expected legacy course_version_id to be zero uuid, got %v", got)
	}
	if got := batch.records[0][9]; got != ev.EditorMode {
		t.Fatalf("unexpected editor_mode: %v", got)
	}
	if got := batch.records[0][11]; got != ev.EventType {
		t.Fatalf("unexpected event_type: %v", got)
	}
	if got := batch.records[0][12]; got != string(ev.Payload) {
		t.Fatalf("unexpected payload: %v", got)
	}
}
